notes: Beixin culture of Shandong; infobox 'c. 5300 - c. 4100 BC'. Extent: the page says 'Fifty sites are located in central and southern Shandong and northern Jiangsu provinces' and puts the type site at Tengzhou; the five discs (Jinan, Taian, Jining, Linyi, Xuzhou, 100 km) are the dossier's reading of 'central and southern Shandong and northern Jiangsu' (confidence 2). Houli before (6500-5500 BC on the Houli page, a 200-year gap), Dawenkou after: the Beixin page dates the Dawenkou '(4100-2600 BC)' while the Dawenkou page gives 'c. 4300 - c. 2600 BC' with an early phase from 4100; 4100 is used as the hand-over and the 4300 start is a disagreement noted in the Dawenkou dossier. The Cishan page calls the Beixin 'its eastern neighbor'; no dates. No area figure.
